label: Alexandros Pliatsikas — the real CV the eval numbers were produced against. Contact details were already stripped when this was written; what remains is technical prose that is public on the CV and profiles it links to.
cvText:
Alexandros Pliatsikas — Junior Fullstack & AI Developer, based in Thessaloniki, Greece.

PROFILE
I am a final-year Applied Informatics student at the University of Macedonia, specialising in fullstack web development and AI integrations.
I build production-ready applications end to end, covering REST APIs, PostgreSQL schemas, React frontends with real-time features, and Docker deployments.
I have hands-on experience with RAG pipelines and OCR systems from my internship and my undergraduate thesis.
I am looking for a fullstack or frontend role where I can ship real product in a team.

WORK EXPERIENCE

Web Developer Intern at E-Avenue, Thessaloniki, March 2026 to May 2026.
I designed and built a RAG-based AI copilot for Jira that queries internal knowledge bases and ticket history to speed up issue resolution.
I developed an OCR pipeline for automated extraction of data from passports and national IDs for user verification in the Rentalbook product.
I handled both projects end to end, from architecture through to deployment.

L1 Technical Support at CQS S.A. / NOVA, Athens, remote, September 2025 to April 2026.
I performed network and equipment troubleshooting for NOVA customers.
I managed tickets through a CRM and diagnostic tools.
I guided customers remotely through equipment setup and connectivity issues.

Waiter and cook, part-time, at Tabya, Thessaloniki, September 2024 to April 2025.
I worked in a fast-paced team environment that required coordination, customer service, time management and multitasking under pressure.

EDUCATION

BSc in Applied Informatics at the University of Macedonia, Thessaloniki, October 2022 to present, currently in my final year.
My coursework covers programming, databases, system analysis and digital marketing.
My undergraduate thesis is on developing and evaluating RAG pipelines for LLM performance benchmarking.
High School Diploma, 1st General Lyceum of Trikala.

PROJECTS

TaskFlow, a fullstack task management SaaS, 2026.
I built a production-ready Kanban application from scratch using a monorepo architecture.
I implemented a REST API with JWT authentication and refresh tokens.
I built drag-and-drop boards and real-time collaboration over WebSockets with Socket.io.
I deployed TaskFlow with Docker and CI/CD, and later migrated its hosting from Railway to a Vercel frontend, a Render backend container, Neon Postgres and Upstash Redis.
TaskFlow stack: Next.js 15, React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Socket.io, Docker, TypeScript.
Repository: github.com/Pliatsikas/TaskFlow.

Undergraduate thesis, RAG pipeline evaluation, ongoing.
I am developing and benchmarking RAG pipelines for LLM performance evaluation at the University of Macedonia, using RAG techniques, LLMs and Python.

Aura, an immersive web experience, 2026.
I built an architectural portfolio site with WebGL fluid simulations using Next.js, React Three Fiber and Framer Motion.
Live at aura-sand-pi.vercel.app, repository at github.com/Pliatsikas/aura-site-demo.

TV repair shop management system, freelance desktop application, 2026.
I built a customer and repair-tracking desktop application that replaced an MS Access database for a local business, using Electron, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma and SQLite.

Game development with Unity, ongoing personal work.
I explore gameplay mechanics and game feel using Unity and C#.

SKILLS

AI and data: RAG pipelines, LLM integration, prompt engineering, LLM evaluation, Google Colab.
Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, CSS3.
Backend and databases: Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, Redis, Socket.io, REST API design, PHP.
DevOps and tools: Docker, Git and GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, JWT authentication, Vercel, Render, Railway, Neon.
Game development: Unity, C#.

LANGUAGES
Greek is my native language. My English is at C2 Proficiency level.

CERTIFICATIONS
Learn RAG, Scrimba, 2026. PHP Crash Course, Udemy, 2026. HTML and CSS, Responsive Design and SQL, Scrimba, 2025. Learn React, Scrimba. Google AI and AlphaFold Seminars, Google. Google Colab and Cloud Computing, Google.

LINKS
github.com/Pliatsikas — pliatsikas.github.io — linkedin.com/in/alexandros-pliatsikas
